systemSubtitle: Methodological management of data cycle and modeling
academicDisclaimer: Academic prototype. The models and scenarios are exploratory, non-clinical, and non-causal, and should not be used alone for making medical or public policy decisions.

dashboard.title: CRISP-DM Methodological Dashboard
dashboard.purposeText: This portal documents and tracks the six CRISP-DM lifecycle phases applied to the Urban Food Environment Digital Twin for Philadelphia. It is an informational tracking interface and does not run ML models directly.
dashboard.iterativeNote: Note: CRISP-DM is an iterative cyclic process. You may navigate freely and return to any phase to update documentation or evaluate new results.

business.title: Business & Public Health Understanding
business.problemText: In urban areas like Philadelphia County, PA, spatial disparities in healthy food access, vehicle ownership, and socioeconomic vulnerability correlate with adult obesity and diabetes prevalence.
business.objectiveText: Develop a data-driven digital twin prototype to explore spatial patterns and evaluate hypothetical food environment policy scenarios at the census tract level.
business.targetVarText: Adult crude obesity prevalence (OBESITY_CrudePrev / CDC PLACES 2022)
business.usersText: Urban health planners, epidemiological researchers, and municipal officials.
business.limitationsText: Academic & exploratory use. Models capture spatial statistical associations, not individual-level causal relationships.
business.scenarioBaseDesc: Current observed access and prevalence conditions in 2022.
business.scenarioTaxDesc: Models consumption reduction using literature-backed price elasticities.
business.scenarioSubsidyDesc: Simulates increased fresh food availability and affordability.
business.scenarioCombinedDesc: Synergistic evaluation of SSB tax and agricultural retail subsidies.
business.scenarioRestrictionStatus: Planned — Not executed in V2.2.0 (Absence of verified georeferenced store coordinates).

data.title: Data Understanding
data.subtitle: Public data source inventory, variable schema, and data quality
data.sourceCDCDesc: Census tract level health prevalence estimates for obesity and diabetes.
data.sourceUSDADesc: Food desert indicators, low-income low-access metrics, and vehicle availability.
data.sourceTIGERDesc: Georeferenced spatial boundary polygons for Philadelphia County census tracts.
data.geoidNote: Technical Identifier Note: GEOID is an 11-digit technical FIPS code (e.g. 42101000100) used for tabular and spatial joins; it is not used as a predictive feature in ML models.

prep.title: Data Preparation
prep.subtitle: Data cleaning, typing, integration, and feature selection pipeline
prep.splitNoticeTitle: National Training & Philadelphia Reserved Evaluation Split
prep.splitNoticeText: To prevent spatial data leakage and ensure rigorous evaluation, all 384 Philadelphia tracts are excluded from the national training set (54,277 US urban tracts) and reserved as an external evaluation set.

modeling.title: Modeling
modeling.subtitle: Algorithm specifications, spatial cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and statistical tests
modeling.processText: A structured CRISP-DM pipeline is used with median imputation for missing values, standardization (for linear models), and 5-fold spatial GroupKFold cross-validation grouped by CountyFIPS.
modeling.streamlitMissing: Streamlit URL is not configured. Check VITE_STREAMLIT_URL in .env file.
modeling.cvSubtitle: 5-Fold GroupKFold strategy by CountyFIPS to prevent spatial data leakage
modeling.tuningSubtitle: Explored search space, regularization criteria, and optimal parameter configuration
modeling.statsSubtitle: Statistical significance between models, residual diagnostics, and spatial autocorrelation

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.subtitle: Metrics analysis, fold performance, and imported training results
evaluation.importDesc: Upload the 'training_summary.json' file exported from Streamlit to inspect model metrics and active configuration.
evaluation.noImportDesc: Run training in Streamlit and export the JSON summary to view metrics in this section.
evaluation.validationNoteText: Technical metrics (R², MAE, RMSE) measure statistical fit on tabular data. They do not constitute clinical validation nor prove causal mechanisms.
